description: This Java source file defines the class EventBusMessage, which acts as a container and utility wrapper for messages transmitted over the Vert.x event bus within the Eclipse Hono project. It handles creation, property management, serialization, and deserialization of request and response messages, including integration with AMQP 1.0 message formats and OpenTracing span contexts.

classes.name: EventBusMessage
classes.description: A wrapper class for messages exchanged via the Vert.x event bus in Eclipse Hono, providing methods for message creation, property manipulation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and integration with AMQP 1.0 messages and span contexts.
